page_title: MAL 1-0 RAY | Mallorca v Rayo Vallecano 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Javier Alberola Rojas has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Mallorca due to an offside in the build-up play.
90+6' The Mallorca players halt their celebrations as referee Javier Alberola Rojas makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+5' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) latches on to a stunning lofted pass just outside the box and fires a blazing shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
90+4' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Rayo Vallecano are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Vedat Muriqi will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
84' The referee signals a substitution. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Sergi Darder.
79' The referee blows his whistle, Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) replaces Manu Morlanes.
75' The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
75' 1 - 0 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) reacts well to a deflected cross from Daniel Rodriguez and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the top right corner. 1:0.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aridane Hernandez is coming onto the pitch as Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) replacing Cyle Larin.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Navarro departs the field of play to be replaced by Valery (Mallorca).
70' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
69' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) for Isi Palazon.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Unai Lopez.
62' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
55' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
55' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is replaced by Sergio Guardiola.
55' Here's the change. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) leaves the pitch and Pathe Ciss comes on as a substitute.
54' The attendance is 18316.

51' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
48' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
48' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

48' Augusto Batalla is a nightmare for the offensive players! Johan Mojica (Mallorca) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.
46' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
46' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Augusto Batalla is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
45+1' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Augusto Batalla.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Samu Costa (Mallorca) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
38' Yellow card. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas had an easy-decision to make.
35' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Dominik Greif makes a save.
34' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

32' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
31' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
30' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
28' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) forces a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
27' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar.
26' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
22' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
22' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner with a short pass.

21' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
21' Mallorca couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
20' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle after Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
15' A cross from a corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

14' This shall not pass! Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
13' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Augusto Batalla intercepts the ball.
11' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Johan Mojica just over the bar.
10' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
7' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
5' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
4' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
2' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from the edge of the penalty area, but the ball flies onto the right post!
1' A pass by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Javier Alberola Rojas.
